body: Worker trap (Termal::BarA1, 2026-10-23 01:40Z, noticed before any run). As a holder of two claimed items, `engram note` with work_ref set to the OTHER held item moves session focus to that item; the reply's focus_change shows it. `engram add` does the same. Test credit follows focus. So after noting on a paused or other held item, immediately re-claim the item whose tests you run next (a same-holder claim renews and moves focus back), and only then launch the run.
